jobs.title: Functional Consultant & Project Manager
jobs.description:
Join BLP Digital — The #1 Solution for ERP Automation 
 BLP Digital is redefining ERP automation with agentic AI. Spun out of ETH Zurich and HSG, we build AI agents that automate finance, procurement, logistics, sales, and more for some of the world's largest enterprises. We solve real enterprise problems with cutting-edge technology and a strong sense of ownership.
 Our solution is live in 40+ countries, used by 550+ customers, and automates 70,000+ processes every day, including for Fortune 500 companies. As one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups, our success stems from deep expertise in technology and business processes, delivering a product with outstanding product-market fit, proven by a growing global customer base.
 We've recently welcomed Goldman Sachs Alternatives as a growth investor, and we're now expanding into the UK and USA. We are just getting started. Ready to build the future? Join BLP Digital today. 
 
 Location
 This is a full-time position. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich, the role will be based remotely or hybrid from Germany or Austria. As team collaboration is of great importance to us, we highly encourage remote team members to join us in Zurich at least once a month. These visits are financially supported by blp.
  
 About the role
 As a versatile professional with a passion for technology, you'll operate at the intersection of business and tech, leading end-to-end implementations of our Native-AI-powered ERP automation products. You'll help customers reimagine their processes, maximize automation rates, and turn their AI initiatives into measurable success.
 If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, take pride in driving results with full ownership, and want your work to have real business impact every single day, this role is made for you.
  
 What you'll do
 Own the implementation journey end-to-end, from understanding client requirements to ensuring smooth delivery, high customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement.

 Translate complexity into clarity: design scalable, tailored solutions that align with customer workflows and business goals.

 Collaborate closely with our engineering team to tackle technical challenges, adapt the system to customers' unique processes, and ensure successful integration with existing systems.

 Be the client's trusted partner: anticipate needs, surface insights, and ensure they realise the full potential of blp's automation.

 Work with sales to design tailored implementation plans aligned with customer needs and drive deep product adoption.

 Feed the product loop: surface what isn't working and translate that feedback into long-term platform improvements.

  
 What you'll bring
 Key attributes for success 
 Ownership and autonomy. You take initiative, move things forward, and deliver results end-to-end.

 Managing ambiguity. You stay calm and effective when information is incomplete or goals shift.

 Growth mindset. You learn fast, seek feedback, and use it to raise your game.

 Problem solving and critical thinking. You approach challenges systematically, using logic and evidence to make decisions.

 Customer-first mentality. You think beyond implementation and care deeply about business outcomes and user value.

 Qualifications 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, or a similar field, or equivalent work experience.

 2+ years of experience in consulting, technical implementation, process automation, or project management.

 Excellent project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

 Proven ability to work cross-functionally and manage multiple stakeholders.

 Strong analytical and communication skills: you can translate business needs into technical action.

 Fluent in German and English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills and confidence working with and presenting to native-speaking clients.

 Experience with ERP environments or cutting-edge AI-driven SaaS solutions is a definite plus.

 Hands-on experience with Procure-to-Pay (P2P) or Order-to-Cash (O2C) process flows is a strong advantage.

  
 What you'll get
 High ownership environment. You shape your projects, outcomes, and career path.

 Impact at scale. Your work powers automation across global enterprises.

 Cross-functional exposure. Work with engineers, data scientists, and business leaders daily.

 Real growth. Fast-paced environment, steep learning curve, and structured career progression.

 Employee ownership. Be part of a self-financed, independent company with a best-in-class stock option programme.

 Amazing team. Become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators.

 Technology exposure. Be at the forefront of emerging technologies and enjoy continuous learning opportunities.

 Visits and offsites. Paid visits and stays at our HQ in Zurich, including collaborative team offsites.

  
 Learn more about bl

Staff Product Manager, Agentic Discovery 
 About Us Constructor powers product search and discovery for some of the largest retailers in the world. We serve billions of requests every week, and you've probably seen our results somewhere and used our product without knowing it. We differentiate ourselves by focusing on metrics over features, and reinventing search and discovery from the ground up as a machine learning challenge with the specific goal of improving metrics like revenue. We're approximately doubling year over year despite the market slowing down and have customers in every eCommerce vertical. We're a passionate team of technologists who love solving problems and want to make our customers' and coworkers' lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they think is best can lead to great things.
 Job Summary We're looking for a systems-minded, AI-native Staff Product Manager to help lead the next chapter of Constructor: Agentic Discovery. As commerce shifts toward agentic experiences, we're investing heavily in a portfolio of AI-powered surfaces — our AI Shopping Assistant, Product Insights Agent, Prism recommendations, and more to come — that change how shoppers discover products and how businesses run discovery.
 This is a high-leverage, high-ambiguity role.  Agentic discovery at Constructor is fundamentally an AI and machine learning problem, so this role lives and breathes it. You'll partner closely with ML, engineering, design, and go-to-market to turn new agentic capabilities into experiences that ship, prove value, and stay under our customers' control — and serve as the connective tissue that aligns multiple teams behind one coherent vision for agentic discovery.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager - DevEx
jobs.description:
Our mission

 We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

 In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

 We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

 Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

 How you'll help us achieve it 

 Your mission is to make it dramatically easier for our engineers to ship features and learn from them quickly, securely, and reliably. You'll aim for small-startup speed while meeting the quality bar of a large financial institution. Velocity here means removing friction and toil from the path between idea and learning, not asking people to work harder.

 AI is a big part of the opportunity, and we're looking for a PM who is optimistic about its possibilities but pragmatic about what actually works. The goal is not to adopt the latest shiny AI tool; it's to deeply understand your internal users, experiment, and honestly evaluate what solves their problems, whether that's AI, process changes, or boring tooling that just works.

 The Technical Product Manager - DevEx will:

 
 Lead a team of engineers with full ownership of how we deliver new features for our users and use AI solutions to remove impactful friction for our engineers and product managers.

 Define product goals, metrics, and roadmaps based on user needs and mission impact.

 Drive user research within our engineering and product teams.

 Write clear, compelling design docs and facilitate async, fast-moving decision-making.

 Over-communicate context, priorities, and decisions to ensure team alignment.

 Adjust priorities quickly based on feedback, experiments, or new learnings.

 Solve problems holistically, whether through product features, ops tooling or process changes.

 
 In this role, you'll... 

 
 Own the developer experience holistically, including any internal or external tooling needed to support it.

 Research and implement solutions for how we can use AI to remove engineering and development friction. 

 Build your own prototypes to test ideas where possible.

 Relentlessly gather feedback (by talking to users and looking at data) to deeply understand the problem space and our engineers' and product managers' needs.

 Work from first principles to understand the engineers' and product managers' biggest problems and then figure out how our tooling should work to solve those problems.

 Prioritize the biggest problems blocking the engineers' and product managers' productivity and the impact on delivering value to our users fast and securely.

 Directly manage the DevEx team to help them grow in their careers, partnering with the Tech Lead, who will own the technical bar.

 
 Key Details 

 
 This is a fully remote role. Candidates must be based in one of our talent hub countries (UK, Spain, USA (East Coast), Canada, Kenya and Ghana) or in one of our operating markets in Africa including Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, or Burkina Faso

 Wave provides a yearly $1,200 stipend to support co-working meetups with teammates.

 Remote team members are expected to travel to our operational markets (e.g. Senegal or Côte d'Ivoire) at least once per year. Exceptions apply, but we've found this key to understanding our users and product.

 Our salaries are competitive and are calculated using a transparent formula. For this role, depending on your level and location, we offer a salary up to $237,500 USD, plus a generous equity package.

 Major benefits:

 
 Subsidized health insurance for you and your dependents, and retirement contributions (both vary from country to country).

 6 months of fully paid parental leave and subsidized fertility assistance.

 Flexible vacation, with most folks taking between 21-30 days per year. 

 $10,000 annual charitable donation matching.

 Have 3+ years of product management experience and hands-on engineering background (you've shipped production code) or direct PM ownership of a developer experience, or developer productivity function.

 Proven success in overseeing all elements of the product development lifecycle, such as user research, design, implementation and evaluation.

 Speak fluent English

jobs.title: Senior Technical Project Manager - PMO (all genders)
jobs.description:
Your creative field We are looking for a full-time, permanent Technical Project Manager (all genders) to join our PMO team as soon as possible. We embrace a remote-first approach (within Germany), but you can choose whether you’d like to work in a hybrid model or entirely on-site, depending on your proximity to one of our locations (Berlin, Hamburg, Cologne, Munich).

 As a Senior Technical Project Manager, you are a cornerstone of strategy execution at Contabo – and you're joining at a time when a lot is moving strategically. Alongside the continued evolution of our existing cloud infrastructure, we are driving initiatives that will expand our portfolio well beyond what exists today over the coming years. This is exactly where your role comes in: embedded in our PMO, you take end-to-end ownership of technical projects across development teams and business functions – including initiatives for which no blueprint exists yet, where you help shape structures from the ground up. 

 You work at the intersection of technology and business: you translate sometimes still ambiguous requirements into executable plans, actively challenge requirements, and structure initiatives into scalable roadmaps, iterations, and implementation phases. In your day-to-day work, you coordinate priorities, dependencies, and delivery sequencing across multiple teams and parallel workstreams, identify resource bottlenecks and delivery risks early, and ensure transparency through structured reporting, clear governance, and effective escalation management – especially when scope and priorities shift in our fast-moving environment. jobs.title: Principal Product Manager
jobs.description:
DomainTools is looking for a Principal Product Manager to join its Product team. Data is the backbone of our products, and this role will be responsible for growing and refining the data products that drive our threat intelligence solutions, with API-first delivery and integration into UI, AI and third-party experiences and workflows. This is a strategic role for the company that has a high impact on the companyâs success, and has a great deal of visibility both inside and outside the company. The ideal candidate is a strong leader and successful product manager with a track record of delivering market-leading data products, with insights derived from direct customer interaction and big-data analysis. If you want to make a big impact in an established, growth-stage company, and if you love data product management, DomainTools is the place to be!
 
 The product manager is expected to contribute to her/his team a solid knowledge of the various constraints of the business, and a prioritized assessment of the opportunities that the business can capitalize on. The product manager must also contribute to the product team a deep knowledge of our users and customers, and an understanding of the platforms that our customers use to engage with our products. Finally the product manager is expected to track industry trends and the competitive landscape as they pertain to their products.Â 
 
 While each member of the product team may be accountable for a specific area, we look for product managers that understand that consistent innovation is the result of each member of the product team contributing their passion and their ideas.Â  The product manager must collaborate closely with engineering, marketing, sales and solutions engineering teams to deliver world-class solutions to market.
 
 This job, as with the other roles on the product team, is an individual contributor role. You will need to be able to influence your teammates, colleagues, stakeholders, and key executives, through your use of data and logic.
 

 Basic Qualifications:
 Minimum 7 years in cybersecurity or data-related product management, delivering data-driven analytics and products
 Deep knowledge of their business and its customers, understanding how data products are utilized by its users, and valued by buyers
 Experience working with threat intelligence products, threat feeds, APIs, and related technologies
 Experience interacting with customers who leverage data warehousing, data science, and Big Data technologies
 Experience with integration of data products into third-party environments (both customer and partner ecosystems)
 Experience working with Agile (kanban/scrum) development teams and processes
 Excellent people skills, working with cross-functional teams across the organization to bring a solution from ideation to market
 Excellent writing, communication, and presentation skills
 US-based, with a willingness to accommodate core hours that overlap at least 9am-3pm US Pacific time

 Preferred Qualifications:
 Experience in cybersecurity investigations, threat defense, incident response, or related activities
 Solid understanding of the cybersecurity market and modern security architectures
 Familiarity with specific data domains used in cybersecurity, including DNS, IP, TLS/SSL certificates, web crawl, BGP, NetFlow data
 Experience with real-time data collection, processing and delivery
 Experience with large language models (LLMs) and agentic workflows
 Experience with data products that leverage predictive analytics / machine learning (ML)
 Experience with distributed systems and cloud computing

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager Photovoltaic & Battery Energy Storage System (BESS), (M/F/D)
jobs.description:
The ILF Solar Photovoltaic & hybrid systems team works across a vast range of large-scale renewables projects and programs, both grid connected and off-grid across private and public sectors globally. We offer you to join a dynamic environment and to work on unique and exciting projects (including floating PV, complex hybrid systems, combination with Hydrogen, rural electrification, etc.).
 
 Join our Team in Munich or Fontainebleau / Paris to contribute to the transition toward a decarbonized and sustainable energy future!
We are looking for a Senior Project Manager Photovoltaic & Battery Energy Storage System (BESS), (M/F/D) 
 

 YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES: 
 You will operate as a Senior Project Manager - Photovoltaic & Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) for strategic projects worldwide. Your clients will include International Finance Institutions (AFD, KfW, World Bank, EBRD, EIB, etc.), national power utilities, major private clients (industrial, project developers, etc.).

 During development phase of the projects, you will lead Feasibility studies of complex power plant systems including system sizing / optimization, CAPEX and OPEX estimation, conceptual / detail design and layout, grid studies (PSS/E, Power Factory), energy master plan studies (PLEXOS, PyPSA), etc. Your activities could also include to lead TDD, LTA as well as Technical Transaction Advisor projects.

 During implementation phase , you will lead the tender design, evaluation of EPC/IPP offers, reviewing and validating the executive design before construction (design vetting). Your will also be overseeing the supervision of the construction, commissioning and O&M phase.

 As an interface between suppliers, IPP / EPC contractors and clients you keep up to date with and pass on market trends, technology development, new products, standards and simulation models.

 Your engineering skills will contribute to the standardization of work processes with the goal of enhancing efficiency and quality.

 You will also support the development of our international activities by preparing proposals and supporting business development initiatives.

 
 YOUR QUALIFICATIONS: 
 Graduated in the field of energy, electrical engineering or similar with a focus on Renewable Energies / Photovoltaics / Energy Storage Systems (ESS).

 At least 10 years of experience in large scale photovoltaic & battery systems with robust project management and engineering skills. Expertise in Wind and Green Hydrogen projects would be a plus.

 Experience with Energy software such as PVSyst, HOMER PRO, and/or Power system Software (Power Factory, PSS/E) is required.

 Understanding of technical aspects of PPA and EPC contracts regarding performance and penalties is required.

 Excellent writing skills

 Very good written and spoken skills in English and in French.

 
 
 
 91% of our employees consider ILF Germany & France a “Great Place to Work”. 
 
 Friendly company culture and diversity in everyday practice 
 Numerous local and cross-regional events strengthen team spirit, and the majority of our employees address each other on a first-name basis. We are particularly proud of the international diversity of our teams, which bring together more than 30 nationalities.

 Modern working environment 
 Across all our locations, our employees benefit from modern, high-quality workstations, including height-adjustable desks.

 Professional development and networking

jobs.description:
Deine Mission bei ucm: Als Technical Product Manager übersetzt du konkrete Probleme von Kunden, flexiblen Mitarbeitenden und internen Teams in Lösungen, die sich im realen Einsatz beweisen und anschließend durch Prozesse, Software oder AI skalieren lassen. Dafür arbeitest du hands-on mit Daten, Prototypen, Automatisierungen und Produktspezifikationen und verbindest Fachbereiche und Engineering vom ersten Problemverständnis bis zum produktiven Einsatz. 

 Du sorgst dafür, dass ucm weniger irrelevante Software baut und erfolgreiche Lösungen schneller im gesamten Unternehmen einsetzt. Software und AI sind dabei skalierende Layer für reale Personalarbeit – kein Selbstzweck. 

 Problem-to-Solution Ownership:  Du analysierst operative Probleme, identifizierst die größten Produkthebel und begleitest Lösungen vom Prototyp über die Spezifikation bis zum produktiven Einsatz und zur Erfolgsmessung 

 Hands-on Prototyping & Delivery:  Du testest funktionsfähige Prototypen mit echten Nutzern und übergibst Anforderungen als kleine, technisch belastbare und messbare Produkt-Chunks an Engineering 

 AI- & Tool-Enablement:  Du arbeitest täglich mit LLMs, AI-Workflows und Low-Code-Tools, automatisierst wiederkehrende Abläufe und machst Lösungen auf neue Märkte und akquirierte Unternehmen übertragbar 

 
 Du willst mehr als einen „Job", du willst gestalten, mitwachsen und dich perspektivisch weiterentwickeln. Vielleicht sogar in Richtung Product Lead? Let's talk.

 Das bedeutet auch: Dinge verändern sich schnell. Prozesse werden neu gedacht. Entscheidungen werden schneller getroffen. Du musst bereit sein, dich anzupassen, umzudenken und Verantwortung zu übernehmen, auch wenn nicht alles vorgegeben ist.
 Unser Setup ist klar: Field steht für Umsetzung und Performance vor Ort. Foundry für den Bau von Technologie, Systemen und Wachstum. Frame für Struktur, Steuerung und Skalierbarkeit. Du kommst nicht in ein fertiges System. Du baust es mit und bist verantwortlich dafür, dass es funktioniert.

 Analyse der wichtigsten Customer-, Candidate- und Operations-Prozesse inklusive ihrer System- und Datenflüsse 

 Identifikation und Priorisierung der größten Produkthebel mit Baseline, Ziel und klarem Entscheidungspfad 

 Funnel-Analysen und Product Analytics als Grundlage für Entscheidungen 

 
 Prototyping & Umsetzung 

 Entwicklung funktionsfähiger Prototypen und Tests mit echten Nutzern – von Matching und Self-Service über Kampagnensteuerung bis Operations 

 Übersetzung validierter Ideen in Short PRDs, Akzeptanzkriterien und messbare Produkt-Chunks für Engineering 

 Verantwortung für QA und Erfolgsmessung – vom erkannten Problem bis zum validierten Pilot in wenigen Wochen 

 
 Automatisierung & Skalierung 

 Übersetzung wiederkehrender manueller Abläufe in wiederverwendbare Prozesse, Automatisierungen und technische Komponenten 

 Praktischer Einsatz von LLMs, AI-Workflows, Low-Code-Tools und einfachen Skripten 

 Aufbau von Lösungen, die sich auf neue Märkte und akquirierte Unternehmen übertragen lassen, ohne jedes Mal neu gebaut zu werden 

 

 Das bringst du mit: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Technical Product Management, Product Operations, Solution Design oder einer vergleichbaren hands-on Produktrolle 

 Sicherheit in Prozessanalyse, Product Discovery, Prototyping, Short PRDs, Akzeptanzkriterien, QA und Erfolgsmessung 

 Technisches Verständnis von APIs, Datenmodellen, Integrationen, Systemlogik und Architektur-Trade-offs

 You contribute significantly to product development and prioritisation.

 You are based in Nuremberg, Munich, or the surrounding area and are able to work from our Nuremberg or Munich office at least three days per week.

jobs.title: Group Product Manager
jobs.description:
Join a winning Team 
 EngagedMD is a Patient Journey Management solution for specialty care that helps practices improve patient experience, reduce administrative burden, and convert more patients to care, faster.
 We embrace a mission-driven culture where committed individuals come together to make a real impact in healthcare. Join us today in our mission to help carers carry on caring.

We’re EngagedMD, a Patient Journey Management solution used nationwide and internationally by over 3 million users since its launch and continues to see enormous growth and adoption from medical clinics across multiple markets. This is an exciting opportunity to join a small and growing team, and to be both strategic and hands-on. You will have the opportunity to set, share, and gain buy-in for the vision for our products, while also closely collaborating with our engineering, sales, customer success, marketing, finance and operations teams. As part of this role, you will be actively leveraging AI on a daily basis to drive roadmap investment decisions and feature direction.

You’ll collaborate with other leaders to manage the software release process while influencing both on-shore and off-shore engineering teams to pursue best-in-class customer experiences for the medical professionals and patients that use our system.

jobs.title: Product Manager Grower Experience (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Über die Position Gestalte mit uns die digitale Infrastruktur des europäischen Gartenbaus 
 Connected Growers entwickelt June: Die Plattform, über die Erzeuger, Käufer und Vermarkter effizient zusammenarbeiten. Wir ersetzen fragmentierte Prozesse durch moderne Software und schaffen eine gemeinsame digitale Infrastruktur für eine ganze Branche. 
 Dafür suchen wir einen Product Manager (m/w/d) für unseren Bereich Grower Experience, der gemeinsam mit Engineering und Design unsere Anwendung für Gartenbaubetriebe weiterentwickelt. 

 Deine Rolle bei June 
 
 Als Product Manager Grower Experience (m/w/d) verantwortest du die Produktentwicklung unserer Anwendung für Gärtner*innen. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO. 
 Deine Nutzer sind Gartenbaubetriebe, deren Bedürfnisse Du durch enge Zusammenarbeit mit diesen und weiteren Experten der Branche kennenlernst. Du entwickelst daraus technische Lösungen und Standards für die Branche.  
 Du definierst relevante KPIs für deinen Produktbereich und misst den Erfolg deiner Arbeit konsequent an ihnen. 

 Anforderungen Was du mitbringst 
 Mindestens 4–5 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement von B2B-Softwareprodukten. 

 Erfahrung im eigenständigen Führen von User Interviews, Bereitschaft zu unregelmäßigen Vor-Ort-Besuchen bei Gärtner*innen. (Führerschein erforderlich)  

 Kenntnisse gängiger Tracking- und Analytics-Tools. 

 Exzellente schriftliche Kommunikation (Roadmaps, PRDs). 

 AI-Erfahrung am Puls der Zeit: Du bist bei neuen Entwicklungen up-to-date und findest wege, wie du AI für Deine Arbeit und eingebettet im Softwareteam effizient nutzen kannst. 

 Fließend Deutsch, sehr gutes Englisch. 

 Das wäre ein Plus 
 Erfahrung mit Prozessen aus der Warenwirtschaft oder aus dem Handel.  

 Ein Software-Background kombiniert mit Product-Management-Erfahrung. 

 

 Aufgabenbereich Was du bei uns bewegst 
 Du verantwortest die Produktstrategie und -roadmap für den Bereich Grower Experience. 

 Du sprichst wöchentlich eigenständig mit unseren Gärtner*innen, baust Beziehungen zu ihnen auf und triffst die Betriebe in unregelmäßigen Abständen auch vor Ort. 

 Du arbeitest eng mit Design und Engineering zusammen, leitest gemeinsam mit Design User Interviews und übersetzt die daraus gewonnenen Erkenntnisse in konkrete Produktentscheidungen, während Du das Team fachlich durch den gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess führst. 

 Du verstehst und artikulierst den Business Value deiner Produktentscheidungen, u. a. über KPI-Frameworks, und nutzt Tracking- und Analytics-Daten, um Annahmen zu validieren und Produktentscheidungen datenbasiert zu treffen. 

 Du kommunizierst Roadmaps, PRDs und Produktentscheidungen klar und überzeugend – schriftlich wie mündlich. 

 Du nutzt AI selbstverständlich in deinem Alltag – für Prototyping, eigene Datenanalysen und einen effizienten, AI-gestützten Produktentwicklungsprozess gemeinsam mit deinem Engineering-Team. 

 Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss auf unser Produkt, unsere Kunden und den Erfolg von June. 

 So arbeiten wir 
 
 Unsere Produktteams verantworten ihre Bereiche vollständig: von der Produktstrategie über User Research und Priorisierung bis hin zum Release und den kommerziellen KPIs ihres Bereichs. 
 Gemeinsam mit Design und Engineering übernehmt ihr Verantwortung für den Erfolg eures Produktbereichs und arbeitet kontinuierlich daran, ihn zu verbessern. 
 Wir sprechen regelmäßig mit unseren Kunden, besuchen sie vor Ort und testen unsere Lösungen gemeinsam mit ihnen. Wir glauben, dass gute Produktentscheidungen nur entstehen, wenn man die Probleme der Nutzer wirklich versteht. 
 Wir arbeiten pragmatisch, treffen Entscheidungen früh und passen sie an, wenn neue Erkenntnisse entstehen. Wir haben starke Meinungen, halten aber nicht dogmatisch an ihnen fest. Verantwortung endet bei uns nicht mit dem Release. 

 Die Perspektive Was dich erwartet 
 Die Möglichkeit, Produktverantwortung für einen der zentralen Bereiche von June zu übernehmen. 

 Die Chance, den europäischen Gartenbau grundlegend zu verändern 

 Ein erfahrenes Design, Product und Engineering-Team an deiner Seite. 

 Großer Gestaltungsspielraum für Produktstrategie und Roadmap. 

 Viel Verantwortung und kurze Entscheidungswege. 

 Modernes, AI-gestütztes Arbeiten im gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess. 

 Die Möglichkeit, unsere Produktkultur aktiv mitzugestalten. 

 Hybrides Arbeiten in unserem Büro in Köln sowie regelmäßige Besuche bei den Gärtner*innen vor Ort. 

 Hinweis:  Die Stelle wird zunächst über Bridgemaker besetzt und im weiteren Verlauf zu Connected Growers überführt.

jobs.title: Technical Product Lead AI Finance App
jobs.description:
About KIRA 
 Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.
 Â 
 In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
 Â 
 Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.
 We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
 We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.
 If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
 
 The Role 
 KIRA is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
 Â 
 These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
 Â 
 The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
 Â 
 We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.
 Â 
 What You'll Own 
 Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

 Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

 Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

 Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

 Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

 Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

 Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.
 Â 

 What We're Looking For 
 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

 Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

 Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

 Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

 Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

 Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.
 Â 

 Nice to have 
 Engineering or highly technical product background.

 Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

 Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.
 Â 

 Outcome 
 Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

 Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

 Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

 AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

 Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

 Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

 Location
 This is a remote role . We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 
 Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.
 
 Language
 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
 
 Interview Process
 Our process is designed to move fast:
 Online assessment or practical task

 Technical interview

 CEO / final round
 

 For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.description:
Company Description 
 We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. 
 
 We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. 

 Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. 

 If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. 

 With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. 
 
 Product Manager: Alternative Payment Processing 
 Checkout.com is seeking a Product Manager and leader to join our team of product managers working to add and improve our Alternative Payment Method (APM) portfolio, with a focus on bank-based payment rails. This role will help drive our company OKR of expanding and enhancing the payment methods we offer merchants around the world, helping these businesses grow their global footprint. The successful candidate will provide cross-functional leadership across product, engineering, and business teams, to ensure our APM portfolio is embedded throughout Checkout.com ’s ecosystem, enabling a seamless experience for our merchants. They will work across the business and engage with merchants to align on the selection of APMs, drive the recommended approach to offer or improve them, design the API experience and collaborate with more than twenty stakeholder teams to deliver APMs end-to-end. Daily tasks include understanding stakeholders’ pain points, driving prioritization for product development, and developing new capabilities for our customers.
 
 About you: 
 3-5 years of product management experience.

 Experience working in payment methods, especially direct debit and account-to-account payment methods

 Data-driven: Skilled at leveraging data and business insights to determine strategic priorities and drive the product roadmap and execution.

 Customer-first: Think from the customer's perspective and can balance future opportunities with immediate needs.

 End-to-end mindset: Think in a structured and diligent manner, understanding all key components necessary to drive the ongoing success of a product.

 Leadership: Excellent at collaborating with stakeholders in product, engineering, commercial, and business teams proactively, demonstrating high EQ and influencing skills.

 Effective communicator: Able to inspire others with a shared vision and simplify complex concepts for a wide range of audiences.

 
 Key responsibilities: 
 Set the strategy for your portfolio of APMs, including understanding the target market, customers and aims for each APM, to determine the best approach for delivering the APMs, and how to balance adding new APMs vs working on enhancements for the existing portfolio, using qualitative and quantitative research and data to make decisions.

 Become an expert in your payment methods, working closely with the payment partners to understand trends and drivers for success, which you will leverage to support our commercial team and drive value for our merchants.

 Work with engineering and product counterparts to design the API and integration for each APM, to deliver an optimal developer experience which balances a consistent API experience across Checkout.com ’s products with the nuances of each different APM.

 Build strong partnerships with business, product, and technology stakeholders and work with them for their buy-in and collaboration to generate momentum for your products

 Work with other product and engineering leaders to ensure alignment with their roadmaps and delivery

 Gain a deep understanding of Checkout.com ’s customers and business. 

 Foster a team culture that upholds Checkout.com ’s operating principles.

 Product Marketing Manager, AI Governance (EMEA)

 About the Role
 Kong is building the connectivity layer for the AI era — securing, governing, and monetizing every LLM, MCP, agent, and API request in production.
 As the Product Marketing Manager for our AI portfolio, you'll be the commercial engine behind the fastest-moving part of our business. Working alongside a team of deeply technical product marketers who own positioning for AI traffic management, agent identity, and AI observability, you'll plan the launches, campaigns, and content that drive pipeline.
 This is a high-leverage execution role. You'll own launches, content, and campaign execution across the entire AI portfolio, serving as the single interface between AI R&D and the demand generation, field marketing, and sales teams that bring our story to market.
 What You'll Do
 Own launch execution across the AI portfolio — Manage the launch calendar, tiering framework, and cross-functional launch process for all AI product releases, coordinating inputs from technical PMM specialists into cohesive go-to-market moments.

 Drive campaign strategy and content — Partner with demand generation and field marketing to build campaign briefs, messaging frameworks, and content assets (web copy, ebooks, webinars, videos) that translate technical differentiation into buyer-relevant narratives.

 Serve as the commercial interface layer — Act as the single point of contact between the AI product marketing team and downstream marketing and sales functions, ensuring consistent messaging across every AI offering.

 Support field and partner enablement — Collaborate with the revenue enablement team to deliver launch-aligned sales assets, talk tracks, and competitive positioning for the AI portfolio.

 Coordinate with event marketing — Drive AI portfolio presence at flagship events, including product announcements, session content, and booth messaging.

 Measure and iterate — Track launch and campaign performance, gather field feedback, and continuously refine messaging and asset strategy based on what moves pipeline.

 Who You Are
 2+ years of experience in product marketing, product management, or solutions engineering — ideally at an AI/ML platform company.

 A genuine, hands-on interest in AI infrastructure. You follow developments in LLM deployment, agentic frameworks, the Model Context Protocol, and AI governance, and can speak credibly to AI platform engineers without bluffing.

 A proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into crisp narratives that land with both technical practitioners and C-suite buyers.

 A track record of developing product launches, sales enablement materials, and competitive intelligence programs that move pipeline and accelerate deals.

 Highly collaborative — you thrive working across Product, Marketing, Sales, and Partner teams.

 Comfortable owning a stage: keynote presentations, analyst briefings, customer roundtables, and demo-heavy sessions energize you rather than intimidate you.

 Experience in open-source software, SaaS platforms, and enterprise go-to-market motions is strongly preferred.

 Familiarity with the AI connectivity landscape — including awareness of competing and complementary vendors across API gateways, AI observability, vector databases, iPaaS, and agentic orchestration frameworks — is a strong plus.

 
 About Kong: 
 Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. Role: Product Owner – Communication Channels & AI

 Location: Manchester

 Hours: Monday-Friday 8:45am-5:15pm

 Package: £80k OTE 

 As Product Owner - Technical Products, your role is to own and continuously improve PHMG's Technical product portfolio, ensuring Cloud Telephony, AI Receptionist and CCE deliver measurable client value, operational quality and long-term commercial growth. 

 You are accountable for translating client needs, technology capability, partner opportunities and commercial priorities into scalable products and service models that strengthen adoption, retention and PHMG's competitive position. 

 Through H2 2026, you will lead the evolution of the technical product portfolio by bringing together product performance, platform capability, roadmap execution, client outcomes, commercial discipline, operational readiness and cross-functional alignment into one coherent product improvement agenda. 

 Key Objectives 

 Core Accountability 

 
 Own the strategy, design and ongoing performance of Cloud Telephony, AI Receptionist and CCE.

 Set a clear, prioritised roadmap that balances client value, technical feasibility, commercial return, operational capacity and partner dependency.

 Ensure Technical products are positioned, sold, onboarded, serviced and renewed in a way that delivers measurable value for clients.

 Define the product standards, service models and client journeys that CS and Technical Production can execute consistently.

 Bring clarity to build, buy and partner decisions so product direction is deliberate, commercially disciplined and scalable.

 
 

 Technical Product Strategy & Roadmap 

 
 Define the long-term direction for Cloud Telephony, AI Receptionist and CCE, including the sequence of capability, integrations and service-model changes.

 Prioritise AI Receptionist growth across both horizontal capability and the vertical use cases where PHMG has the strongest right to win.

 Create a clear approach for CCE in the existing base, reducing under-utilisation and turning technical review, onboarding and value evidence into retention levers.

 Partner with the Creative Product Owner so the full product set feels coherent to clients and to the teams selling and servicing it.

 
 Client Experience, Adoption & Value Evidence 

 
 Define the client experience for Technical products across onboarding, configuration, in-life usage, renewal and offboarding.

 Clarify how clients access, configure and understand product value through the portal, including call flows, AI Receptionist behaviour, CCE setup and usage analytics.

 Ensure CS has the standards, data and language needed to evidence value, drive adoption and manage client expectations confidently.

 Identify where clients slow, stall or disengage, and build product or service-model interventions that protect retention.

 
 Commercial Performance & Partner Discipline 

 
 Own the commercial logic of the Technical portfolio, including pricing, CAC, cost-to-serve, gross margin, revenue performance and investment cases.

 Operationalise the GoTo resell model with clear pricing, service, process and margin controls while protecting the partner relationship.

 Use data to assess where Technical products create incremental value, where they cannibalise existing activity and where the model needs to change.

 Make active trade-offs between speed, quality, margin, client experience and platform investment.

 
 Operational Delivery & Launch Readiness 

 
 Work with Technical Production and Tech to define standards, SLAs, runbooks and support models for each product and release.

 Ensure new capabilities do not go live until operational readiness, client communications, CS briefings and support routes are clear.

 Create tight governance for launch decisions, technical dependencies, client escalations, recurring provisioning issues and partner constraints.

 Keep accountability clear between Product, Tech and Product Operations so issues are solved at the right level rather than absorbed by CS.

 
 Insight, Reporting & Continuous Improvement 

 
 Maintain a reliable view of product performance across adoption, usage, NPS, retention, revenue, margin, service issues and operational friction.

 Build structured feedback loops with CS, Client Insights, Sales, Tech and Technical Production to identify product problems worth solving.

 Turn recurring client or operational issues into permanent product, process, reporting or service-model improvements.

 Use performance data to make early decisions before product issues become retention, margin or client-experience risks.

 BLP Digital is redefining ERP automation with agentic AI. jobs.description:
Head of Product (f/m/d) 
 About TACTILIA: 
 At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. Spun out of Schunk, the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup.
 This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now. Your work will directly shape the product, roadmap, and development process that make that possible.
 You will join at the moment when the hard robotics questions become real product decisions: how do we turn customer needs into a highly capable robotic hand that is reliable, manufacturable, and ready to deploy on a real shop floor?
 The Role 
 As Head of Product at TACTILIA, you will be the operational backbone of our product development. You will turn customer requirements into a robust roadmap — and the roadmap into a product that reaches the customer on time, on budget and at production quality.
 You will lead through structure, clarity and commitment rather than hierarchy, and report to the CTO. You will work across product development, engineering and customer needs, keeping priorities aligned as TACTILIA moves from development towards production and scale.
 What you will do 
 Own the product roadmap. Turn customer and market needs into clear product priorities and continuously balance customer value, engineering effort, technical risk, and time-to-market.

 Turn requirements into product decisions. Work with Applications and customers to translate needs into clear, testable specifications, maintaining traceability from RFQ through validation.

 Orchestrate product development. Coordinate Mechatronics, Software, Electronics, Systems Engineering and Applications across milestones, dependencies and interfaces, resolving conflicting priorities when needed.

 Drive the product to production. Own development milestones, gate reviews, budget, unit cost and quality through to production readiness, while helping establish a scalable product development process.

 Make the hard trade-offs. Bring together customer needs, technical feasibility, cost, quality and schedule to make pragmatic decisions and keep development moving.

 Stay close to customers. Support the CTO in technical customer discussions, feasibility assessments, RFQs, trade fairs and partner conversations, bringing market feedback back into the product.

 Build the organisation around the product. Identify gaps in capacity, skills and ownership across engineering, translate them into concrete hiring needs, and make pragmatic make-or-buy decisions.

 Build for the real world. Work with engineering and operations to ensure the product is not only technically capable, but manufacturable, testable, reliable and ready to scale.

 What you bring 
 A degree in Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a comparable technical field.

 7+ years of experience developing complex mechatronic or hardware products, including significant experience in product development or technical project/programme management.

 A proven track record taking products from requirements through development to production readiness.

 Strong requirements management and a solid understanding of systems engineering.

 Experience leading complex, multidisciplinary teams without direct line authority.

 Strong product judgment and the ability to balance customer needs, technical feasibility, cost, quality and time-to-market.

 A hands-on, structured approach and the ability to move between strategic decisions and day-to-day execution.

 Fluent English; German is a strong plus.

 Bonus 
 Experience in robotics, drive technology, gripping technology, or other highly integrated mechatronic systems.

 Experience in a startup or scale-up environment, or a corporate spin-off.

 Familiarity with relevant robotics, machinery or functional safety standards.

 The next chapter of robotics won't be built in a lab. It will be built by people who care about what happens when technology meets the real world.
 At TACTILIA, you'll work on one of the hardest open problems in robotics: giving machines the dexterity, reliability, and robustness they need to interact with the physical world at industrial scale.
 The technology is taking shape. The team is being built. And the standards for robotic hands and their skills are still wide open.
 That means your decisions will have a lasting impact — not just on a product, but on what comes next for Physical AI.
 Build the hand. Define the standard. Shape what comes next. 
 If you're excited by the challenge of building robotic hands that work reliably in the real world, we'd love to hear from you.

Exolaunch is a global leader in launch mission management, satellite integration and satellite deployment technologies. With a decade of flight heritage and over 830 satellites launched across  48 missions to date, Exolaunch leverages industry insight to tailor turnkey solutions that meet customer needs and respond to market trends. The company fulfills launch contracts for industry leaders, the world's most innovative startups, research institutions, government organizations, and international space agencies.

Key to our success is a combination of an expert Mission Management team, our growing portfolio of in-house designed and market leading separation systems, and our rideshare structures including EXOtube . Rideshare structures are the answer to a growing diversification of launch opportunities coupled with a market seeking flexible and agile access to space for a growing number of satellite constellations. The EXOtube Product Manager  is a multi-faceted role which combines technical management of complex development and launch planning projects with customer and market facing Business Development and Sales work. You will be coordinating the development and qualification of EXOtube projects , becoming intimately familiar with how our products function and how we execute our missions. You will also help the business team in marketing and selling EXOtube projects, shaping how it is seen on the market and helping us identify market demand. 

 Your role is based at our headquarters in Berlin, Germany . The ideal candidate for this role has a background in space technology, structural design and environmental testing for space, is an excellent communicator and team player, and is passionate about being part of a dynamic team that is driving the satellite industry forward. 

 Your mission Manage the requirements, design, qualification and launch planning of EXOtube projects . 

 Lead communication with customers and ensure a fluent progression of the project. 

 Help develop concepts for Ground Support Equipment and test hardware and coordinate with suppliers. 

 Plan and participate in test and launch campaigns internationally. 

 Create and maintain documentation incl. User Manuals, Sales materials, technical reports and internal and external procedures. 

 Work hand-in-hand with the Sales team to answer prospect’s questions regarding Exolaunch’s capabilities and services, including EXOtube’s compatibility with different launch vehicles and other Exolaunch products. 

 Solidify and expand upon Exolaunch’s commitment to customer care and service excellence . 

 Write proposals alongside the business team to bid for the hardware development and launch of satellite constellations. 

 Attend space conferences and industry events – represent Exolaunch at the highest professional level 

 Gather customer requirements and work with the engineering teams to iterate on and improve Exolaunch product offerings and cultivate new business opportunities. 

 

 Your profile Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in structural, mechanical or space engineering or a similar field. 

 5+ years of engineering work experience. 

 Experience in customer-facing work and sales work. 

 Excellent written and spoken English. 

 Excellent technical communication skills. 

 Strong experience in working with CAD software such as SolidWorks. 

 Strong sense of style and form to be able to integrate Exolaunch style into documentation and hardware design. 

 Positive attitude and ability to work in a highly integrated team setting.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager [Machine Learning expertise]
jobs.description:
Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot , based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here ). 

 Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve , Qonto has grown to 1,600+ Qontoers serving over 600,000+ customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started. 

 Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit. 

 AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work ( here ) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it. 

 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ 
 

 Join us as a Staff Machine Learning Product Manager to enhance Qonto's customer experience through innovative solutions. You'll drive the maturity and scalability of our ML/AI capabilities, addressing concrete business problems while fostering innovation.

 ➡️ What you'll do 

 
 Own the ML product roadmap end-to-end: Define what we build, why, and in what order — gathering insights from engineering, data science, and business teams to develop a prioritized strategy that addresses real customer needs.

 Drive key ML product initiatives: Lead the definition and design of ML solutions for products like Attachment Matcher, Transaction Categorizer — from discovery through delivery.

 Collaborate across the full stack: Work with data scientists, engineers, and business stakeholders to ensure successful implementation of ML capabilities that drive measurable business value.

 Own your decisions and communicate them clearly: Articulate the rationale behind priorities and engage key stakeholders — including customers, product, and executive teams.

 Continuously improve through data: Monitor and analyze the performance of models and products, making data-driven recommendations to raise the bar.

 
 ➡️ What we're looking for 

 
 Product management experience with an ML focus: You have proven experience in product management, with concrete examples of ML products you significantly scaled. You think in outcomes, not features.

 Technical fluency in ML: You have a solid grasp of machine learning concepts and applications, allowing you to collaborate effectively with technical teams and translate complex ideas into product requirements.

 Strong stakeholder management: You excel at building relationships with diverse stakeholders and communicating complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

 Analytical thinking: You make data-driven decisions that balance customer needs with business objectives — and you're comfortable with hard trade-offs.

 Strategic vision: You can develop a compelling product vision and roadmap that aligns with company goals and delivers measurable impact.

 
 ➡️ What we can offer you 

 
 A domain being reshaped by AI: ML is transforming financial services — from expense categorization to cashflow forecasting. You'll build products at the frontier of what's possible, not maintain existing ones.

 Squad autonomy as the default: You own your roadmap and ship without red tape. No approval chains, no waiting on committees.

 Real impact at scale: Your work will directly affect how 600,000+ SMEs manage their finances every day.

 Cross-functional collaboration: You'll sit at the intersection of product, data science, and engineering — with a team that values craft and moves fast.

 
 

 
 ➡️ About your future manager 

 You'll work closely with Sophie , Manager of the AI Lab. Sophie has led cross-functional teams through the full product lifecycle at both fast-growing startups and established tech companies. She partners directly with Product and Tech leadership to align the AI roadmap with Qonto's strategic goals.

 Her approach: give engineers real ownership, create space for experimentation, and empower the squad to adapt their ways of working in pursuit of real impact.

 At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick — who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along. 

 

 By applying, you agree that Qonto processes your personal data to assess your application. Your data is kept for up to 2 years in our candidate pool. Read our Privacy Notice for full details.

 ➡️ Mission

 Join us as a Product Manager for Due Diligence and help build one of the most sophisticated compliance engines in Europe. You'll own how Qonto verifies who its 600,000+ customers are — from their first sign-up to their next periodic review — under the guidance of Quentin , our Director of Product for Customer Lifecycle.

 

 ➡️ What you'll do

 Design agentic compliance workflows: You'll build AI-driven decisioning that automates routine checks end-to-end, reserving human judgment for the cases that truly need it.

 Partner daily with Ops: You'll ship changes that directly shape the daily work of a large, global operations team.

 High-stakes impact: Your work will touch every Qonto customer, at every stage of their relationship with us.

 A growing scope: As Qonto opens new markets and legal forms, your remit will keep expanding.

 Direct access to leadership: You'll work closely with Quentin and the wider Customer Lifecycle product team on how Qonto builds trust at scale.

jobs.title: Junior Product Owner
jobs.description:
Your journey ROMEO is the queer company behind the legendary ROMEO dating app, one of Europe’s longest-standing dating platforms for queer communities. We are looking for a Product Owner to join our Product team in Berlin and help shape how ideas and product requirements make their way into the hands of millions of users.

In this delivery-focused role, you will work closely with Product Management, Design, Engineering, QA and BI to turn product priorities into clear, actionable work for our development teams. It is a great opportunity to grow your product skills while taking real ownership of the day-to-day delivery process.

 Your typical day Support the Product Management team in refining product requirements and translating approved PRDs into implementation-ready epics, user stories and tickets.
 Ensure user stories have clear acceptance criteria and are sufficiently refined before entering development.
 Maintain and order the backlog according to priorities set by product leadership.
 Take part in regular and ad hoc meetings to clarify product requirements with development, design and other delivery teams.
 Support our two-week delivery cycle by ensuring development teams have the information and decisions they need to proceed.
 Identify missing requirements, dependencies, open decisions and blockers early, and escalate them to Product or Delivery.
 Work closely with QA to communicate product and release priorities, clarify acceptance criteria, and support defect triage and release-readiness decisions.
 Support product acceptance and release readiness by checking delivered functionality against agreed requirements and acceptance criteria.
 Support the BI team by translating product questions, KPIs and tracking needs into clear data requirements.
 Ensure agreed analytics requirements are captured as part of delivery, including relevant event tracking before work is considered complete.
 Maintain clear and up-to-date product documentation in Jira and Confluence.
 

 We look for You are passionate about building products for LGBTQ+ communities and interested in contributing to the continued development of ROMEO.
 You have initial experience in a Product Owner or similar product delivery role, ideally in a B2C environment. Experience in social, dating or community products is a plus. Being familiar with how our product works is a plus.
 You have experience writing or refining user stories and acceptance criteria.
 You have a good understanding of Agile product development and ideally hands-on experience with Scrum and/or Kanban.
 You are comfortable working with Jira and Confluence. Experience with Xray is a plus.
 You are organised, detail-oriented and reliable in following work through to completion.
 You proactively follow up on missing information and drive requirements towards clarity.
 You are based in Berlin or willing to relocate and are happy to work from our Wittenbergplatz office at least three days per week.
 You have excellent written and spoken English skills, ideally at a native or near-native level.
 

 What We Offer A hands-on role working on an established European digital product during a significant phase of product and technology transformation.
 Close collaboration with Product, Design, Engineering, QA and BI,
 Hybrid working (3 days per week in our Berlin office at Wittenbergplatz)
 €40 employer contribution towards the Germany Job Ticket
 EGYM Wellpass (only €20/month employee contribution)
 In-house German classes
 Annual learning budget (e.g. for conferences, courses, certifications)
 International team, English-speaking environment

jobs.title: Product Manager Intern
jobs.description:
Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace. 
 

 Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence. 
 

 Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines. 
 At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth. 
 

 How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here. 
 

 We're looking for a curious Product Manager Intern to join our team and contribute to the evolution of Aircall's core product. You'll work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Data, Design and Go-to-market to turn customer feedback into product improvements, align on tradeoffs across teams, and help shape the experience our customers rely on every day. This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys talking to customers, is comfortable navigating ambiguity, and likes untangling problems that cut across multiple product areas. to join our team and contribute to the evolution of Aircall's core product. You'll work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Data, Design and Go-to-market to turn customer feedback into product improvements, align on tradeoffs across teams, and help shape the experience our customers rely on every day.  Key Responsibilities : 
 
 Customer Insights & Product Development 

 Meet directly with customers to gather feedback, discuss pain points, and validate potential improvements.

 Synthesize qualitative and quantitative feedback into clear opportunities, and translate them into product recommendations that shape the roadmap.

 Partner with Product, Design and Engineering to define requirements and prioritize enhancements that improve user experience and agent efficiency.

 Align dependencies and facilitate tradeoff discussions with stakeholders across product areas.

 Follow the development cycle end-to-end to ensure we ship the best possible experience in an agile manner.

 Contribute to Knowledge Base articles, FAQs and product demos to support launches and go-to-market.

 

 Product Analysis & Optimization 

 Gather and synthesize usage and performance data from multiple sources (interaction logs, analytics, customer feedback).

 Identify patterns, bottlenecks and opportunities in product workflows, and turn them into more intuitive experiences.

 Use modern data tools and, where relevant, AI/LLM-based approaches to enrich analysis and uncover deeper insights.

 

 Monitoring & Performance 

 Research, recommend and help implement tools and frameworks for tracking key product metrics (e.g. latency, reliability, usability).

 Collaborate with teams to define and monitor KPIs aligned with product goals.

 Help set up dashboards, alerts and reports to support ongoing performance evaluation and decision-making.

 Qualifications : 
 

 Master's student from an engineering or business school or university.

 Fluent in English.

 Comfortable running customer conversations — asking good questions, listening carefully, and following up.

 Comfortable working across teams, aligning dependencies and navigating tradeoffs with peers and stakeholders.

 A first experience (internship) in a product or project team is a plus.

 Knowledge of SaaS, product development cycles, and our business is a plus.

jobs.title: Product Manager | Intch
jobs.description:
About Intch
 Intch is a professional social network with a marketplace for part-time work. You can think of it as a professional network built for senior specialists who take on meaningful contracts alongside their main work. A typical contract lasts from three to six months. The product is used in 140 countries and is available in up to 20 languages. Intch has fewer than 40 people and four product areas, with three already live and one preparing to launch. Intch is rethinking how people and companies find each other and build trust online.
 
 What you’ll do
 Own the B2C product end to end, including its P&L.

 Set the product direction and own the 3–6 month roadmap across strategy, experimentation, and delivery.

 Drive growth through hypothesis-driven experiments and measurable improvements in acquisition, activation, and retention.

 Own the product metrics and use data to guide decisions and prioritisation.

 Conduct CustDev interviews and build a deep understanding of user behaviour across a global, multilingual audience.

 Partner with the B2B product teams to make the B2C product the connective layer across Intch’s product ecosystem.

 Report directly to the founder and take over the product vertical they currently lead.
 

 What you need to succeed
 5+ years of experience in product management.

 A strong B2C growth track record, including experiments, acquisition, and measurable results.

 Proven experience scaling a product that already has strong product–market fit.

 A strong record of improving key metrics such as growth, activation, and retention.

 Strong product sense and a hypothesis-driven approach to problem-solving.

 Comfort working with data and translating insights into action.

 Experience working in a startup or another fast-moving, high-ownership environment.

 High autonomy, accountability, and comfort working without micromanagement.

 Fluent Russian.
 

 What you get
 Full ownership of a profitable, fast-growing product and its P&L, reporting directly to the founder.

 A deliberately compact team (under 40 people) where everyone has a large area of ownership and streamlined collaboration.

 Metrics-driven culture: every function, including support and payments, owns numbers. Your P&L is your scoreboard.

 Flat, cross-pollinating structure: anyone in the company can bring a validated idea to your product. You can do the same across other verticals.

 Paid vacation and sick leave.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (all genders) | B2C
jobs.location: Remote oder Köln / Darmstadt / Düsseldorf / Berlin
jobs.description:
Anstellungsdetails Permanent Contract, Full- or Part-Time, Remote or Cologne / Düsseldorf / Darmstadt / Berlin

 Info Who we areWe are the tech powerhouse behind Kaufland’s international online marketplaces and a company within the Schwarz Group. Driven by a start-up mentality and working on an equal footing within flat hierarchies, we develop the best marketplace solutions for our customers, sellers and partners. #FromEuropeForEurope

Day by day, our Tech & Product Team of about 400 experts pursues the goal of creating the best possible customer shopping experience for our online marketplace. Through innovative technical developments, they not only create an outstanding shopping experience but also lay the foundation for an optimal selling experience for our sellers. Learn more about our division, areas, and cross-functional teams here !

 Aufgaben Your tasks – this is what awaits you in detail You lead the product strategy, vision, and roadmap for B2C products on the Kaufland Global Marketplace, aligning company goals with customer needs
 You collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, data, and marketing, to deliver high-quality digital products
 You design and ship LLM-powered product features that elevate the shopping experience and shape how people shop, from the first concept and prompt design through evaluation, quality monitoring, and continuous iteration in production
 You drive a rigorous experimentation culture: you form hypotheses, design and run A/B tests, and turn results into product decisions that drive customer engagement and conversion
 You define tracking concepts together with analytics teams and use funnel and behavioral data to continually optimize the product so customers can discover, evaluate, and buy the right products with ease
 You work hand-in-hand with UX designers and researchers to craft intuitive customer journeys, validate them through user research and usability testing, and iterate fast
 You identify customer needs and pain points at scale through behavioral data, user research, and market trends, and prioritize the opportunities that create the most value
 You stay on top of AI and e-commerce trends and proactively identify how emerging technologies can create value for our customers
 

 Profil Your profile – this is what we expect from you You have a true builder mindset and a passion for turning ideas into reality
 You've successfully taken a product from scratch, owning everything from early ideation and concept development to execution and delivery
 You have hands-on experience building LLM-based features into consumer products, not just using AI tools for your own productivity 
 You bring solid B2C product experience, ideally in e-commerce or another consumer product at scale
 You are data savvy and outcome-focused: you design and evaluate A/B tests, define tracking concepts, and answer the right questions based on data
 You always think customer first: you have a strong feel for UX, understand end-users' pain points, and derive actionable insights from research and data
 You are a motivated and empathetic communicator who is experienced in collaborating with software development teams and interacting with different stakeholders

The Virtual Private Cloud team develops the core networking layer of Nebius AI Cloud.

We provide secure and isolated private networks, connectivity from cloud resources to internet and external networks, and networking services such as routing, security groups, load balancing and VPN connectivity.

We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to drive complex initiatives spanning VPC, adjacent cloud services, and infrastructure layers. Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google and Booking.com.

Als  Senior Product Manager Claims (w/m/d/x)  übernimmst du End-to-End-Verantwortung für einen strategischen Kernbereich der EMIL Insurance Suite und gestaltest, wie Versicherer Schäden digital, automatisiert und kundenfreundlich abwickeln, von der Meldung bis zur Auszahlung. Wenn du ein Produkt strategisch und operativ aufs nächste Level heben willst, ist das deine Rolle. 

 WAS DICH ERWARTET Entwickle eine klare Vision und priorisierte Roadmap für den Claims-Bereich und treibe als Motor den Produkterfolg voran, von der Schadenmeldung (FNOL) bis zur Auszahlung. 

 Gestalte die Automatisierung des Schadenprozesses: regelbasierte und KI-gestützte Schadenprüfung, Dunkelverarbeitung und effiziente Workflows bis zur Regulierung und Auszahlung. 

 Treibe strukturierte Discovery-Prozesse voran und schreibe gestochen scharfe Requirements, damit wir gemeinsam mit Engineering & QA zügig und in hoher Qualität shippen. 

 Baue KI aktiv in deinen Arbeitsalltag ein, um auf einem höheren Level zu agieren, z. B. mit strukturierten Prompts für schnelle Prototypen, automatisierten Pipelines für User-Feedback oder datengestützten Specs. 

 Kommuniziere Prioritäten glasklar an Leadership und Kunden und miss den Erfolg deiner Features datengetrieben, immer mit der Stimme des Users im Ohr. 

 Gestalte eine reibungslose Zusammenarbeit im Schadenprozess für alle Beteiligten, von der Statuskommunikation über Task Management bis zu dynamischen Dokumenten-Templates. 

 

 WAS DU MITBRINGST 7+ Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement im B2B SaaS-, InsurTech- oder FinTech-Umfeld; Erfahrung mit Schadenprozessen oder Kernsystemen von Versicherern ist ein starkes Plus. 

 Starker operativer Drive und klare Outcome-Orientierung: Du übernimmst von Tag eins an echte Ownership und treibst Initiativen bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung voran. 

 AI Fluency: Du kannst nachvollziehbar aufzeigen, wie KI deine Arbeit in den letzten Monaten messbar schneller oder besser gemacht hat (z. B. wiederverwendbare Prompts, AI-gestützte Datenanalyse, automatisierte Workflows). 

 Fundierte Kenntnisse in agilen Frameworks und Requirements Engineering sowie sicherer Umgang mit gängigen PM-Tools (Jira, Figma, Analytics). 

 Exzellente analytische Fähigkeiten sowie verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch (C1), um zwischen Tech und Business souverän zu vermitteln.

 Qualifikation
